title: LLM for Qualitative Coding
description: We investigate how researchers with different levels of experience use LLMs in qualitative analysis, exploring how AI shapes analytical reasoning, decision-making, and reliance through think-aloud studies..
label: Leading Project · Collaboration with Stanford · Human–AI interaction · Qualitative research

title: Simulation for Architecture
description: We explore how AI-based stakeholder simulations can support human-centered architectural design. Through designer interviews and prototype development, we aim to inform future creativity support tools for architecture.
label: Leading Project · Creativity support tools

title: Experience-Centered Spatial Simulation (ECSS) Framework
description: We introduce a generative-agent framework for simulating how different stakeholders perceive, interpret, and experience architectural spaces, exploring the potential of AI to model diverse human perspectives and dynamic spatial experiences.
label: Leading Project · Generative agents · Agent-based simulation
